name: Caragon-Viner
description: Caragon-Viner was a distant planet in the Caragon-Viner system of the Colonies that held a Jedi outpost during the High Republic Era. Jedi Master Stellan Gios was once stationed there alongside Jedi Knight Indeera Stokes.
